questions.question: Kamal saves x% of her monthly income. When his monthly expenditure is increased by 20% and the monthly income is increased by 26%, then his monthly savings increased by 60%. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Kamal saves x% of her income 

Increase in his income = 26% 

Increase in his expenditure = 20% 

Increase in saving = 60% 

**Concept used:**

Income = Saving + Expenditure 

**Calculations:**

Let income of Kamal be 100 

Saving of Kamal = 100 × (x/100) = x

Expenditure of Kamal = 100 – x 

Kamal's salary after increment = 100 × (126/100) = 126

Kamal's expenditure after increment = (100 – x) × 120/100 = (100 – x) × 6/5 

New Saving = 126 – (100 – x) × 6/5 ----(1) 

New saving after increment = x × 160/100

New saving after increment = 8x/5 ----(2)

From eq. (1) and eq. (2)

⇒ 126 – (100 – x) × 6/5 = 8x/5 

⇒ 126 – 120 + 6x/5 = 8x/5

⇒ 6 = (8x/5) – (6x/5)

⇒ 6 = (8x – 6x)/5

⇒ 30 = 2x

⇒ x = 15

**∴ The value of x is 15**

questions.question: The area of a parallelogram ABCD is 300 cm², The distance between AB and CD is 20 cm, and the distance between BC and AD is 30 cm. What is the perimeter (in cm) of the parallelogram?
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e89760c9f2f37f18b422c7a1b25a781487f063e3c7bad7aa082046f330ffcac7.png] 

The area of a parallelogram ABCD is 300 cm2

**Concept used:**

Perimeter of a parallelogram = 2(a + b)

Area of a parallelogram = a × b

Where a and b is any side and height of the parallelogram from the opposite side

**Calculation:**

According to the concept,

CD × 20 = 300

CD = 15

Again 

AD × 30 = 300

AD = 10

So, Perimeter = 2 (15 + 10)

⇒ 50 cm

**∴ The perimeter of the parallelogram 50 cm**

questions.question: A solid metallic sphere of radius 8.4 cm is melted and recast into a cone of height 18.9 cm. What is the radius (in cm) of the base of the cone?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the sphere = 8.4 cm

Height of the cone = 18.9 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of cone = (πR²h)/3

Volume of sphere = (4πr³)/3

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e1717efc210ef81e097c845450f890bdb16ca48b6b663556d1d09a5bb86ac1f.png] 

According to the question,

(4π × 8.4³)/3 = (πr² × 18.9)/3

⇒ 4 × 8.4³/18.9 = r²

⇒ (4 × 8.4 × 8.4 × 8.4)/18.9 = r2

⇒ 125.44 = r2

⇒ 11.2 = r

**∴ The radius of the base of the cone is 11.2 cm**

questions.question: To do a certain work, the ratio of the efficiencies of A and B is 7 : 6. Working together, they can complete the same work in 21 days. What part of the same work will be completed by B alone in 26 days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The efficiencies of A and B is 7 : 6

They can complete the same work in 21 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Time × efficiency 

**Calculation:**

Total work = 21 × (7 + 6)

⇒ 273

Now In 26 days B will complete 26 × 6 = 156

So, B completed = 156/273

⇒ 4/7

**∴ B alone will be completed 4/7 part of the work in 26 days**

= 57 × 4 = 228

questions.question: Some fruits are bought at 11 for ₹100 and twice the number at 8 for ₹100. If all the fruits are sold at 9 for ₹100, then what is the profit or loss percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

CP of some fruits = Rs. 100 for 11

Twice the number of fruits = Rs. 100 for 8

SP of all the fruits = Rs. 100 for 9

**Calculation:**

Suppose 88 fruits are bought at a rate of 11 for Rs 100, then cost of 88 fruits = 8 × 100 = Rs. 800

176 fruits are also bought at a rate of 8 for Rs 100, then cost of 176 fruits = 22 × 100 = Rs 2200

Total cost of 264 fruits = 800 + 2200 = Rs. 3000

SP of 9 fruits = Rs. 100

SP of 1 fruit = Rs. 100/9

SP of 264 fruits = Rs. 8800/3 [∵ 100/9 × 264]

⇒ Total loss = 3000 – 8800/3 = Rs. 200/3

∴ Required loss percentage = [(200/3)/3000] × 100

⇒ 200/9000 × 100 = 2(2)/(9)

**∴ The loss percentage is 2(2)/(9)**

questions.question: In a class of 92 students, the ratio of the number of boys to that of girls is 12 : 11. The average score of the girls, in a test 33(1)/(3)\%, is more than that of boys. If the average score of all students is 80, then what is the average score of girls?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of the number of boys to that of girls is 12 : 11

The average score of all students is 80

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/No. of elements

**Calculation:**

Number of boys = 92 × 12/23 = 48

Number of girls = 92 × 11/23 = 44

Total score of boys and girls = 80 × 92 = 7360

Let average score of boys be 3x

So, average score of girls is 4x

According to the question,

144x + 176x = 7360

⇒ 320x = 7360

⇒ x = 23

⇒ 4x = 92

**∴ Average of girls is 92**

questions.question: Let x be the largest 4-digit number which is divisible by each of 16, 21, 24 and 28. The sum of the digits of X is:
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

LCM method to find the number

**Calculation:**

LCM of 16, 21, 24, 28 is 336

Now we know highest 4 digit number is 9999

So, the x should be close to 9999

If we divide 9999 by 336 we get 29 as quotitent

So the number is 29 × 336 = 9744

Sum of digit = 9 + 7 + 4 + 4 = 24

**∴ Required answer is 24**

questions.question: A train covers a distance of 108 km at a certain speed. If its speed is increased by 18 km/hr, it would take 18 minutes less to cover the same distance. What is the original speed (in km/hr) of the train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 108 km

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/time

**Calculation:**

Let speed of the train be x km/h

According to the question,

108/x - 108/(x + 18) = 18/60

⇒ [(108x + 1944)/x(x + 18)] = 3/10

⇒ 1944/x(x + 18) = 3/10

⇒ 19440 = 3x² + 54x

⇒ 3x2 + 54x - 19440 = 0

⇒ x2 + 90x - 72x - 6480 = 0

⇒ x(x + 90) - 72(x + 90) = 0

⇒ (x + 90)(x - 72) = 0

x = 72 or - 90

So, speed = 72 km/h as speed can't be negative

**∴ Required speed of the train is 72 km/h**

questions.question: By selling an article for ₹720, a shopkeeper gains 20%. If he sells it for ₹210, what is his gain or loss percentage?
questions.solution:

SP = CP + CP × Profit%

So, according to the question,

x × 6/5 = 720

⇒ x = 720 × 5/6

Now new SP = 210

questions.question: A sum amounts to ₹11,616 in 2 years and to ₹12,777.60 in 3 years, when the interest is compounded annually. The sum (in ₹) is:

A sum amounts to ₹11,616 in 2 years and to ₹12,777.60 in 3 years

A = P(1 + r/100)t

A = Amounts

P = Principal 

r = Rate

t = time

**Calculation:**

Let principal be P

and rate be r

According to the question,

11616 = P(1 + r/100)²

12777.6 = P(1 + r/100)³

So, P(1 + r/100)3/P(1 + r/100)2 = 12777.6/11616

⇒ (1 + r/100) = 1.1

Now, 11616 = P(1 + r/100)2

11616 = P(1.1)²

⇒ 11616/1.21 = P

⇒ P = 9600

So, principal = Rs. 9600
